name: Danit Niwattananan
headline: CDTM | RCI @ TUM | CV @ RobCo | Ex-Research @ Fraunhofer
summary:
I am a German-speaking international student at Technical University of Munich (TUM) who is pursuing a Master's in Robotics, Cognition, Intelligence. I am interested in Computer Vision, LLM, and multi-modal models and would like to apply my knowledge to build products in early startups, especially early seeds and Series A or B.

Feel free to contact me if you are interested!

positions.title: Working Student Computer Vision
positions.description:
• Optimized a zero-shot sim2real synthetic detection and segmentation training pipeline for industrial applications, boosting bbox/segm mAP by ~35/30 points while reducing training costs by 10%. Conducted rigorous ablation studies and managed end-to-end data formatting via Roboflow
• Implemented an automated, robotic touchscreen UI element testing system. Achieved millimeter-level operational precision by executing extrinsic robot-camera calibrations for a stylus-equipped robotic arm
• Prototyped 6D Pose Estimation using MVTec HALCON for high-precision object localization. Integrated 2D image data and 3D point clouds to ensure robust detection of industrial parts in varying lighting and occlusion scenarios.

positions.title: Co-Software Lead
positions.description:
• Co-led the software team of ~10 students developing autonomous software stack for a Martian rover for European Rover Challenge 2025 competition, achieving 22nd place out of 102 applying teams
• Spearheaded software recruiting by coordinating lecture visits with professors, pitched and presented our team, and processed written application and conducted interviews
• Oversaw software team organizational aspects and project management via Notion

positions.title: Bachelor Thesis
positions.description:
•	Thesis: Visual-based Panoptic Scene Completion (PSC) for autonomous flight and driving applications using the SemanticKITTI dataset (Grade: 1.0) under Computer Vision Group of Prof. Cremers
•	Responsibilities: Adapted existing state-of-the-art Semantic Scene Completion (SSC) transformer-based model for PSC task using PyTorch Lightning, Hydra, and Numpy. Preprocessed and implemented automatic data cleanup of the SemanticKITTI dataset using custom filter and algorithms via sklearn. Trained, evaluated models, and finetuned hyperparams in Kubernetes containerized environments, monitored via Grafana. Visualized inference results with Mayavi and Matplotlib

positions.title: Tutor - Preliminary Math Course for EI (Vorkurs Mathe für EI)
positions.description:
Helped approx. 25 first-semester students to solve math problems by applying acquired knowledge from the course lectures. The goal is to familiarise the students with often used mathematical fundamental concepts they will encounter in their study in B.Sc. Electrical Engineering and Information Technology.

The topics include mathematical symbols, logic, vectors and matrices, trigonometry, differentiation and integration, differential equations, one-dimensional and 2-dimensional extreme value calculation, and complex numbers.
